program_en: B.S.Sc. in Diplomacy and International Studies
program_chi: 外交與國際事務社會科學學士
learning_outcomes:
Learning outcomes 1. Major Programme: Upon completion of this Major Programme, students will be
able to: (1)  |  acquire a thorough understanding of international
governance, diplomatic strategies/practices from multiple perspectives. (K)
(2)  |  acquire an in-depth understanding of China’s
policy-making and practices in diplomacy and its role in international
affairs. (K)
(3)  |  analyze global affairs from a social science
perspective while understanding the operational rules of the international
community from a legal standpoint. (S/V)
(4)  |  develop diplomatic skills and establish strong
professional networks for future career development. (S)
K = Knowledge outcomes S = Skills outcomes V= Values and attitude outcomes

Studies:  |  9
Students are
required to study outside Hong Kong for one academic term in a partner
institution via an exchange programme administered by the Programme, the
Office of Academic Links or the Colleges, and complete at least 9 units
of courses related to Diplomacy/International Relations/Law approved by
the Programme Director. Grades obtained in these courses are not included
in the calculation of GPA. Students who are unable to obtain the required
units from partner institutions must make up the shortfall by completing
appropriate courses at CUHK, subject to the approval of the Programme
Director.

Explanatory Notes:
1.  |  DIPL courses at 2000 and above level as well as those
labeled as # will be included in the calculation of Major GPA for honours
classification.
2.  |  Students are responsible for the extra costs incurred
in relation to the summer course, internship, field study, and exchange
study in mainland China or foreign countries.
[a]  |  ECON1210 can only be counted towards the fulfillment
of the Programme’s Core Course requirement as specified in 2(a) of the
Study Scheme. Students must take an alternative course to fulfill the
Faculty Package requirement.
[b]  |  Classes to be conducted at the China Foreign Affairs
University.
[c]  |  Students must complete an internship lasting not less
than six weeks.
